caption: The drawing depicts a wooden hand plane tool positioned horizontally in the center of a plain, light beige background. The hand plane has a rectangular wooden body with a smooth grain, rendered in shades of brown with darker and lighter areas suggesting depth and light reflection. At the top of the tool, there are two handles: one at the far left with a prominent upward curve, and another at an angle toward the right, both with rounded ends. Between these handles is a small, round knob. The metal blade, slightly rust-colored, is inserted at an angle in the middle right of the wooden block, visible through a circular opening in the lower central part of the hand plane. There is a shadow cast below the tool, giving the appearance that it is slightly raised from the surface. In the lower right part of the background, there is a small, neat handwritten inscription that reads "OSCAR B. LIHME." There are no additional objects or imagery present; the focus remains solely on the detailed rendering of the single woodworking tool.
title: Plane
